Hi there, I'm Olive Turon, Head of People & Culture at TestGorilla. I'm excited to share more about the Senior People & Talent Operations Partner role and our team.

About TestGorilla

At TestGorilla, we're on a mission to place 1 billion people in their dream jobs. To democratize opportunity, we're building the world's leading skills-based talent discovery platform - one that replaces reliance on resumes with scientific validation of what people can truly do.

Founded as a 100% remote company in 2020, our global team is united by high standards, a lot of heart, and a relentless drive to conquer new technological frontiers. We're all AI-fluent builders who care deeply about replacing bias with fairness.

After empowering thousands of companies to hire smarter and faster, we're now unlocking the next phase of our scale-up journey - where you'll play an instrumental role in creating a world where skills matter most!

About the role

As our Senior People & Talent Operations Partner, you'll own People Ops as a product: the systems, compliance, and self-serve workflows that let most of People & Culture run itself day to day, plus the tooling behind how we hire. You'll join a lean, two-person team, working directly with me, with proper and lasting ownership from day one.Â 

Payroll, compliance, and HR systems across every (35, currently!) country we operate in are foundational elements of this role. Just as critically, you'll build and own the AI/automation and self-serve layer that keeps our People function lean, bringing a product mindset to everything you touch.Â Letâs face it: weâre a scale-up, so youâll also need to be happy wearing other People hats when the moment requires.

We're looking for someone autonomous, opinionated and candid, who'll tell me when I've got it wrong. You'll be dealing with real people and real problems, so you'll need to stay empathic but boundaried, structured and organized even when the pace picks up.

Iâm biased, but I think itâs a dream job: this is an HR role in an HRTech company changing the world of work for the better, weâll have immense amounts of fun, thereâs plenty of uncharted territory for you to make your own, and Iâm committed to helping you to do the best work of your life.

A quick check: if you've never built objectively clever automations (not just used one someone else built), this probably isn't the role for you. Automation is just that central to the job.

Responsibilities

In this role, your responsibilities will include:

- Upholding TestGorilla's behaviors and fostering an inclusive, supportive culture.

- Designing, building and maintaining a smart, automated and AI-enabled people journey - from pre-boarding to off-boarding - that frees up capacity for bespoke, white-glove treatment where it matters

- Being the technical owner and orchestrator of our HR tech stack: evaluating and enhancing it, ensuring these tools are not siloed but unified and integrated.

- Owning the non-Finance side of payroll, invoicing, contract administration, and compliance end to end, across every country we operate in.

- Owning data privacy and recordkeeping, and the day-to-day relationship with our EOR vendor.

- Owning configuration and troubleshooting of our hiring tooling, so hiring managers can run their own searches independently.

- Owning the documentation that makes self-serve actually work in practice, ensuring that itâs structured in a way that is easily accessible to both humans and P&C AI agents.Â 

- Working with me to maintain a clean line between what's self-serve and what needs a person. We do not aspire to automate our entire People journey here.Â 

What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who:

- Is passionate about TestGorilla's mission to help one billion people find their dream jobs.

- Has excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Has built and owned sophisticated automations (Zapier, n8n, Make.com, and the like) as a core part of an integrated HR tech stack, not just used AI tools day to day. Arguably the most important thing on this list.

- Has managed payroll, compliance, or HR operations across multiple countries, ideally through an Employer of Record or a mix of EOR and direct entities.

- Has deep, hands-on HRIS experience. HiBob experience is a big plus, and so is experience assessing or migrating HR systems.

- Brings a product mindset: builds for the people who use them (employees and managers), listens to their feedback, and iterates rather than building in isolation.

- Thrives in a high-autonomy, async-first, remote-only environment, and has worked in these kinds of teams and working cultures before.

- Marries operational rigor with genuine empathy and a real interest in people. You'll be dealing directly with team members, sometimes on sensitive matters.

- Is opinionated and candid, with excellent feedback and stakeholder management skills.

Most people in this role will have acquired these skills over five years of relevant experience. That being said, we care far more about what you've owned, your impact and how you've progressed, than the exact number of years.

We seek diversity and encourage applications from everyone, even if your experience doesn't exactly match the description. Studies show that women and underrepresented groups can be hesitant to apply unless they meet every requirement - let's buck that trend!

Bonus skills

While these skills aren't a requirement, we'd be very interested to hear from you if you have any of the following:

- Experience with an ATS or hiring platform such as Ashby, Greenhouse, or Lever.

- Experience with an EOR provider such as Remote, Deel, or Oyster.

- HRIS implementation or migration project experience.

- Experience supporting a team through organizational change.

What's in it for you?

Please note: In this role, you'll be hired as an Individual Contractor.

- Global Team: Join a fully remote, mission-driven team from around the world.

- Competitive compensation: â¬56,520 - â¬70,650 base pay + Share Appreciation Rights (SARs). This role doesn't carry a bonus component.

- Remote & flexible work: Work from almost anywhere*. Enjoy flexible hours and asynchronous work to balance work and life.
*Check out the countries we currently hire from here .

- Remote work budget: â¬1,000 available each year, or up to â¬2,000 from day 1 if you're buying a laptop!

- Growth & development: Invest in yourself and your career with a 3.5% L&D budget per year and clear growth opportunities.

- Parent/Caregiver support: We provide a caregiver-friendly work environment with paid 8-16 week parental leave and tailored return-to-work approaches.

- Work-life balance: Our unlimited and flexible time off policy empowers you to take the time you need to recharge and maintain your well-being.

Interested?

At TestGorilla, we believe your skills speak louder than your resume. That's why we champion a skills-first approach, using cutting-edge, AI-powered assessments to uncover your true skills and experience match.

When you apply, you'll get to experience our platform firsthand by taking an assessment â it's your invitation to shine and show us what you can do! While our platform is powered by AI, every hiring decision is made by humans. Check out our Applicant Privacy document to see how we protect your data.

Given the hiring sprint timeline above, we'd love to see your application land before September 20.

Concerned about test anxiety or need help with the assessment? We've got you covered. Please check out our candidate support page for any questions. Accommodations are readily available as part of the assessment setup, and requesting support will never impact your application.

title: Social Comms
description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr 

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. 

The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

- You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
- You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.

- You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
- You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
- You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
- You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
- You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
- You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.
Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

description:
Blackbird Interactive is a creative-fueled, future-driven, independent game studio where the best talent in the industry can find long-term careers to help grow their abilities while working on a wide range of projects, which encompass world-class IPs as well as our own creations across multiple genres.

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada. 

Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n 

Responsibilities 

- 
Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

- 
Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

- 
Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

-

-

- 
Experience influencing design direction for high-impact product areas, systems, platforms or pillars, not only individual features or flows. 

- 
Strong cross-functional leadership skills and the ability to work fluently with product managers, engineers, data partners, customer-facing teams, senior stakeholders and other designers. 

- 
Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to simplify complex ideas, lead critiques and workshops and persuade through rationale, evidence and craft. 

- 
Passion for improving team operations, design standards, processes, tools, documentation and better ways for teams to work. 

In This Role, You Will

Lead design strategy and execution for one or more product pillars from discovery through delivery. 

- 
Translate customer needs, business goals, product strategy and technical constraints into clear experience direction and design roadmaps. 

- 
Partner with product and engineering leaders to define product vision, prioritize opportunities and align teams around high-quality outcomes.

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview 

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale. 

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

- Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

- The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

- Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

- We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

- A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

- Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

- You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

- A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

- Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

- Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

- Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work 

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation 

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Engineering Manager Thailand
description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future

Â 

The Role 

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region. 

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships. 

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology â setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own 

- Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

- Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

- Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

- Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

- Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

- Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

- Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

- Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

- Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

- Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

- Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For 

- Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

- Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

- Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

- Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

- Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

- Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

- Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

- Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

- Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

- Strong ownership mentality â when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For 

- Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

- Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

- Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

- Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

- People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

- Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar 

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Â 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical / engineering leadership interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

- Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes. 
- Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements. 
- Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed. 
- Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise. 
- Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility. 
- Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port. 
- Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures. 

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

- Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
- Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
- Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work. 
- Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required. 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
- Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations. 
- Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format. 
- Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities. 
- Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work. 
- Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery. 
- Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise. 
- Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions. 
- Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others. 
- Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. 

Physical Requirements:

- Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory. 
- The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively. 
- The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential. 
- Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment. 
- Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling. 
- The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities. 
- Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs. 
- The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required. 
- Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required. 

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

- Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
- Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
- Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
- Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

title: Head of Security
location: New York, New York, New York, United States
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. 
- Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. 
- Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. 
- Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. 
- Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. 

What You'll Bring

- Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. 
- Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. 
- An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. 
- Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. 
- Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. 
- Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. 
- Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. 

What's Cool About The Role

- You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. 
- A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. 
- We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. 
- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. 
- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. 
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook. 

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. What you will do - Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
- Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
- Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
- Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
- Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
- Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
- Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.

- Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.

- Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
- A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.

How we work
We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers - A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
- Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
- Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
- The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
- Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

This is a great role for someone with some experience in SaaS or online customer support who wants to keep developing their technical, communication and customer-facing skills in a friendly, remote-first team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Troubleshooting problems

Using our support tools

- Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

Helping customers feel looked after

- Using support tools such as Front, Intercom, Zendesk, HubSpot or similar

Working Hours

This is a remote role, for people based in either the UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only). Youâll also need regular overlap with the UK team for training, collaboration and handovers.

The exact working pattern will depend on your location and the coverage we agree, but you should be clear in your application about where youâre based and what working hours you would expect to keep.

title: Internship Product Management Energy Products & Tariffs (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5° , we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free . To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow. 

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

As a member of our Global Product Management Team for Energy Tariffs, you will play an active role in a visionary and dynamic group committed to revolutionizing the global energy sector. Building upon our Heartbeat AI Platform, our mission is to develop energy tariff products across our core markets, take operational and commercial ownership of them, and shape new regulatory products end-to-end. You sit at the center of product, regulation, commercial, and operations, and turn a fast-moving energy market into customer value.

- Drive Your Own Initiatives: Take ownership of well-scoped topics within our energy tariff portfolio, from analysis to recommendation to implementation. You lead your own initiatives and are accountable for their outcomes.

- Contribute to Our Energy Tariff Products: Work on our dynamic electricity tariff products across core markets, driving product improvements, feature rollouts, and customer experience initiatives.

- Support Regulatory Product Launches: Contribute to the launch of new products driven by regulatory change (e.g. Direktvermarktung), helping translate regulatory requirements into concrete product decisions.

- Analyze & Improve Marktkommunikation Processes: Dive into our market communication workflows, identify inefficiencies, and drive initiatives that make our energy retail engine faster and more reliable.

- Monitor Performance & Iterate: Leverage customer feedback, competitive analysis, and market trends. Monitor KPIs to help optimize product adoption and overall customer satisfaction.

- Prepare & Present: Prepare and present findings and recommendations to relevant Product Managers and stakeholders.

Dein Profil

General:

- Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Energy Management, or a related field

- At least one prior internship, working student role, or comparable work placement (in energy, consulting, product, or a fast-moving startup environment preferred)

- Strong ownership mindset - comfortable driving your own initiatives with minimal handholding (with support always available from your direct lead)

- Analytical and structured thinker, comfortable with data and spreadsheets (Google Sheets a must, SQL or Python a plus)

- Proactive, curious, and eager to learn in a fast-moving environment

- You are a team player who enjoys collaborative environments and is always looking to leverage the group’s potential

- Available for at least 6 months, ideally full-time

- Excellent written and spoken English and German

Market & Domain Exposure:

- Previous experience or knowledge of the energy market is a plus but we are happy to get you up to speed - it’s the motivation that counts!

- Basic understanding of European energy market structures, dynamic tariffs, or the energy transition landscape

Benefits

- You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen

- With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate

- Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

- You will enjoy direct contact with core decision-makers

- You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe's most thriving scaleups

- You can work in one of our offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich

- Create a healthy balance alongside your work and enjoy all the benefits of the EGYM Wellpass

- Benefits and discounts are yours with Futurebens

- Whether city bike or e-bike - be flexible with our job bike leasing and do something good for the environment at the same time

- Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Software- und Entwicklungsprojekte und führst diese hinsichtlich Zielerreichung, Qualität, Termin, Budget und Risiko zum Erfolg.

Benefits

title: Lead, Special Projects
description:
About ActAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

About the Role 

You will be responsible for building and running the operational infrastructure behind ActAI.

This includes setting up new offices and entities, implementing payroll and local operations, managing vendors, supporting recruiting operations, and ensuring the company can execute efficiently as it scales.

You will be responsible for operational execution across markets.

What You Will Be Doing 

- Lead business operations across multiple countries.

- Manage and develop a team of Business Operations Partners.

- Oversee office setup, entity incorporation, and market launches.

- Oversee payroll implementation and local operational requirements.

- Manage external vendors and service providers.

- Support recruiting operations, recruiter onboarding, and hiring activities.

- Plan and execute company events, offsites, and operational logistics.

- Track key initiatives and ensure actions are completed on time.

- Improve processes where needed to increase speed and reliability.

What You Will Need 

- Experience in business operations, strategic operations, founder's office, or similar roles.

- Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments.

- Comfortable working across recruiting, finance, legal, and administrative functions.

- Able to identify problems, make decisions, and drive execution independently.

- High ownership and willingness to take responsibility for outcomes.

How We Work 

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

Interview Process 

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

Applications are reviewed by members of our leadership and hiring teams. Interviews may be conducted virtually or onsite.

We value speed, transparency and decisiveness throughout the process.

description:
Designery ist eine spezialisierte Agentur für Ärzt:innen & Zahnärzt:innen. Wir verbinden hochwertige Gestaltung mit intelligenten IT-Lösungen. Unsere Vision: modernes Marketing mit Wirkung, effizient, individuell und bezahlbar.

Wir sind ein 15-köpfiges Team mit flachen Hierarchien, klarer Vision und smarten Tools. Bei uns zählt dein Input, nicht dein Titel.

Als Head of Delivery verantwortest du unsere gesamte Leistungserbringung: Projektmanagement, Webdesign, Web Support, Social, Search, Foto, Video, Brand & Print. Du führst ein Team von sechs Mitarbeitenden, steuerst unser Freelancer-Netzwerk und trägst die Umsatzverantwortung für den gesamten Delivery-Bereich. Dein Auftrag: dafür sorgen, dass unser Wachstum nicht in Überlastung oder Qualitätsverlust kippt, sondern kontrolliert und wirtschaftlich passiert. Du berichtest direkt an den CEO.

Aufgaben

Umsatz und Wirtschaftlichkeit 

- Du verantwortest das Umsatzziel des Delivery-Bereichs und steuerst es monatlich gegen den Plan

- Du entscheidest, was intern gemacht und was extern eingekauft wird, und behältst dabei die Marge im Blick

- Du erkennst unbezahlten Mehraufwand früh und stellst ihn ab, statt ihn zu verwalten

Führung und Entwicklung 

- Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung des Delivery-Teams über alle Gewerke hinweg

- Du entwickelst Menschen weiter, statt Aufgaben nur zu verteilen: du erkennst, was jemand als Nächstes lernen muss, und sorgst dafür, dass es passiert

- Regelmäßige Leistungsreviews mit klaren Erwartungen, echtem Feedback und dokumentierten Maßnahmen

- Du erkennst Unterperformance und strukturelle Engpässe früh und handelst, statt zu hoffen

- Steuerung und Qualitätssicherung unseres Freelancer-Netzwerks

Delivery-Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit 

- Gesamtverantwortung dafür, dass Projekte sauber, termingerecht und wirtschaftlich rausgehen

- Du bist die Eskalationsinstanz bei kritischen Projektabweichungen und entscheidest, statt zu moderieren

- Systematische Reduktion von Rework, Verzögerungen und Qualitätsmängeln durch klare Standards und Abnahmekriterien

Prozesse und Skalierbarkeit 

- Weiterentwicklung und Effizienz aller Delivery-Prozesse

- Standardisierung dort, wo sie Qualität, Geschwindigkeit und Skalierbarkeit erhöht, und nur dort

- Du sorgst dafür, dass Workinstructions vollständig, aktuell und im Team verbindlich angewendet werden

Ressourcen und Kapazität 

- Gesamtüberblick über Auslastung, Engpässe und Abhängigkeiten

- Aktives Gegensteuern bei Überlastung und bei Leerlauf

- Überstunden sind bei uns kein Steuerungsinstrument

Qualifikation

- Du hast Delivery, Produktion oder Projektmanagement in einer Agentur oder einem Dienstleistungsunternehmen verantwortet

- Du hast bereits ein Team geführt und weiterentwickelt, fachlich wie persönlich

- Du hast Erfahrung darin, externe Dienstleister und Freelancer zu steuern, inklusive Qualität und Kosten

- Du behältst über mehrere Fachdisziplinen den Überblick, ohne in jeder selbst Expert:in zu sein

- Ein Umsatzziel zu verantworten ist für dich nichts Neues

- Auslastungs-, Soll-Ist- und Projektmargenrechnungen liest du ohne fremde Hilfe

- Du entscheidest auch bei unangenehmen Themen und stehst danach dazu

- Du unterscheidest den Einzelfall vom strukturellen Problem und behandelst beides unterschiedlich

- Du sagst Sales auch mal Nein, wenn eine Zusage nicht lieferbar ist

- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, weil unsere Kund:innen Praxen in Deutschland sind

Benefits

- Echte Entscheidungsbefugnis : Priorisierung, Prozesse, Ressourcen, Budget. Du entscheidest, du musst nicht überzeugen.

- Klarer Rahmen : Wir arbeiten nach Scaling Up. Ziele, Rhythmen und Verantwortlichkeiten sind schriftlich definiert, nicht Auslegungssache.

- Weiterentwicklung, die nicht nur im Vertrag steht : Du bekommst ein eigenes Budget für Fortbildung und Coaching und einen festen Rhythmus, in dem wir über deine Entwicklung sprechen, nicht nur über deine Zahlen.

- Flexible Urlaubsplanung : Du entscheidest, wann du deine Auszeit brauchst. Denn Erholung ist wichtig.

- 4-Tage-Woche : Unsere Erfahrung zeigt dass eine Arbeitswoche auch in 4 Tagen gelingt.

- High-End Technik : MacBook & Co. für produktives Arbeiten, natürlich auch zur privaten Nutzung.

- Urban-Sports, Jobrad & Co. : Deine Fitness und Mobilität liegen uns am Herzen. Ob Urban Sports, Jobrad oder Deutschlandticket, du hast die freie Wahl.

Danach entscheiden wir, und danach wirst du bei uns bewertet. 

Das sind unsere fünf Core Values. Sie stehen nicht zur Dekoration hier, sie sind Teil jedes Feedbacks und jeder Beurteilung.

- Wir spielen auf Sieg. Jeder kennt seine Zahl und findet selbst den Weg dorthin. Auf Anweisungen warten wir nicht.

- Wir sind Zuverlässig. Wir haben unsere Themen im Griff. Nicht unsere Ausreden.

- Wir machen unser Fach besser. Können setzen wir voraus. Profi ist, wer sein Fach weiterbringt, statt es nur zu beherrschen.

- Zufrieden ist zu wenig. Wir liefern, womit niemand gerechnet hat. Unsere Kund:innen empfehlen uns, ohne dass wir fragen.

- Wir sagen, was wir denken. Scheinharmonie ist Respektlosigkeit in Zeitlupe. Klarheit ist unsere Form von Wertschätzung.

Wenn dich das eher abschreckt als anzieht, sind wir vermutlich nicht die richtige Adresse. Wenn du beim Lesen genickt hast, sollten wir reden.

So läuft es ab 

Express-Bewerbung: Erstes Kennenlernen in 15 Minuten per Video. Schnelle Rückmeldung, wie es weiter geht. Danach folgt ein längeres Gespräch vor Ort und ein Team-Kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Aramaz Digital ist eine wachsende Recruiting-Beratung mitten in Bielefeld. Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, als Arbeitgeber wahrgenommen zu werden und verlässlich passende Bewerbungen zu bekommen. Weil Fachkräfte in fast jeder Branche knapp sind, wächst unser Markt Jahr für Jahr weiter – ein guter Zeitpunkt also, hier einzusteigen.

- Wir bilden dich aus, statt dich ins Wasser zu werfen: Du startest mit einem strukturierten Onboarding, bekommst Schulungen zu Akquise, Beratung und Personalgewinnung und hast von Anfang an feste Feedbackgespräche.

- Du analysierst, warum die Personalgewinnung eines Unternehmens nicht liefert – Zielgruppe, Positionierung, Kanäle, Prozessgeschwindigkeit.

- Du planst Recruiting-Kampagnen, steuerst sie über die Laufzeit und justierst anhand der Zahlen nach.

- Du arbeitest sauber im CRM, kennst deine Kennzahlen und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.

- Recruiting-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Zielgruppenansprache, Kanalauswahl und Prozessgestaltung zusammenwirken – ob aus Agentur, Personaldienstleistung oder Inhouse.

- Beratungsstärke: Du triffst mit deinen Fragen den Kern, denkst in Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass Entscheider mitgehen.

- Vertriebsbereitschaft: Neue Kunden zu gewinnen gehört für dich dazu und schreckt dich nicht ab.

- Zahlenaffinität: Du liest Kampagnendaten, erkennst Muster und handelst danach.

- Eigenverantwortung: Du steuerst dich selbst, hältst nach Rückschlägen Kurs und misst dich an Ergebnissen.

- Vergütung ohne Obergrenze: Fixgehalt als sichere Basis, dazu eine Provision, die nicht gedeckelt ist.

- Unbefristet vom ersten Tag an: Wir planen langfristig – in einem Markt, der stabil wächst.

- Klarer Entwicklungspfad: Recruiter, Junior Consultant, Senior Consultant. Das Tempo bestimmst du.

- Einarbeitung mit Struktur: Umfassendes Onboarding, Trainings zu Recruiting, Beratung und Vertrieb, dazu feste Feedbackrunden.

- Ausstattung auf Niveau: Höhenverstellbare Tische, Herman-Miller-Stühle, Apple-Hardware – mitten in der Bielefelder Innenstadt.

- Fitness auf unsere Kosten: Premium-Mitgliedschaft im Studio deiner Wahl.

- Gut versorgt: Siebträgerkaffee von Julius Meinl, ausgesuchte Tees, flexibles Mittagsangebot über Meyer Menü.

- Flache Hierarchie: Leistungsorientiert und kollegial, mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

Der Ablauf

- Bewerben in zwei Minuten – Lebenslauf genügt, kein Anschreiben nötig.

Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. title: Senior Manager, Site Merchandising UK
description:
ABOUT QUINCE 

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

- Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. 

- Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. 

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE 

Senior Manager, Site Merchandising - UK 

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Manager, Site Merchandising to own the customer journey across the Quince UK site—our largest and most important market. This role sits at the intersection of storytelling, strategy, and data. You’ll be responsible for how products and content come to life on the site to attract, engage, and convert customers.

Beyond optimizing the onsite experience, this role will take a leading position in SEO and organic growth, leveraging content and site merchandising tools to drive awareness, discovery, and traffic. You’ll use insights and data to ensure Quince’s unique value proposition shines through every page—from homepage to product detail.

This role will participate in shaping our growth in the UK and EU through leveraging our global tools and processes, helping improve them and developing impactful localization strategy and tactics across web and app. You’ll partner closely with Marketing, Creative, Category Management, and Engineering to ensure site merchandising supports both brand and business goals.

This role requires being onsite at our London office four days a week.

Responsibilities 

- Lead the end-to-end merchandising strategy for the Quince UK website and mobile apps, ensuring a seamless and inspiring customer experience.

- Manage and optimize merchandising tools and platforms that power product discovery, personalization, and site and app performance.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Marketing, Creative, and Data teams to align onsite experiences with seasonal campaigns, assortment shifts, and brand priorities.

- Partner with global teams to ensure improvements to tooling, automation, merchandising best practices can be easily adopted in the region as well as improving our key metrics.

- Use analytics and testing to continuously improve site navigation, product placement, and content engagement.

- Own site merchandising calendar and execution for key selling moments (e.g., Black Friday/Cyber Monday, holiday, new launches).

- Drive best practices in product storytelling, cross-selling, and navigation to improve engagement and conversion.

- Partner with Engineering and Data teams to implement content automation, metadata structuring, and semantic optimization that improve site crawlability and ranking in AI search results.

- Stay ahead of evolving SEO landscapes (Google’s SGE, OpenAI’s search integrations, etc.) to ensure Quince ranks prominently in next-generation search ecosystems.

Qualifications 

Required: 

- A minimum of 5+ years of experience in site merchandising, ecommerce, digital merchandising, site optimization, or growth/SEO 

- Proven track record of an end-to-end customer journey across web and app for a high-volume consumer brand.

- Experience leading a merchandising or digital experience function for an international or multi-market business and strong localization expertise.

- Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using A/B testing, web analytics tools (e.g., GA4, Amplitude, Mixpanel), and experimentation platforms.

- Advanced knowledge of SEO foundations: metadata, internal linking, site structure, schema marketup, crawlability.

- Strong understanding of UK/EU ecommerce consumer behavior, online buying patterns, seasonal trends, and regulatory considerations.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to handle multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Experience leading a design-forward team that is obsessed with pixel-perfect craftsmanship.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

- 4 days onsite at our London office is required.

Preferred: 

- Personalized customer experience across multiple channels. 

- Demonstrated experience applying AI tools.

- Track record of success in fast-scaling, high-growth environments, ideally in direct-to-consumer (DTC) or omnichannel commerce.

- Familiarity with search & merchandising tools (Bloomreach, Algolia). 

- Familiarity with SEO platforms (Botify, Semrush). 

- Familiarity with A/B testing tools (Optimizely, VWO) and product analytics tools (Looker, Tableau). 

- Excited by super-IC role with broad scope and impact.

WHY QUINCE?

title: Customs Specialist (Europe)
description:

About Nivoda 🚀 

Nivoda is a rapidly scaling global B2B diamond and gemstone marketplace connecting jewellery retailers with competitive, high-quality suppliers worldwide. Processing $300M+ in annual transactions and operating across multiple regions, Nivoda is transforming a $350B industry that has historically been slow to modernise.

Our Mission 🎯 

Nivoda started with a simple observation: buying and selling diamonds was slow, opaque, and inefficient, no matter how big or small your business was. Our platform fixes this by giving every jewellery business, wherever they are in the world, the same access to inventory, financing, and logistics as the biggest players in the industry.

About the Role 🤔 

As we expand into jewellery and new markets, the complexity of moving products across borders has grown fast. Loose diamonds have historically had simple customs treatment in most jurisdictions; jewellery is a different story, with its own tariff regimes and duty rules. This is a new, dedicated role that will sit within fulfilment, close to the shipments and the broker relationships where trade compliance actually gets executed day to day preparing documentation, applying classifications, managing broker performance, and owning our duty drawback program end to end. Legal & Compliance own the policy layer: the classification framework, country-of-origin rules, and regulatory interpretation. You'll partner with them constantly and escalate anything genuinely unclear, but this role owns execution.

It's an individual contributor role with high ownership; there's no capability like this at Nivoda today, so you'll be building the operating rhythm as you go, not inheriting one.

What will you be doing? 😎 

- Prepare all shipment documentation and commercial invoices, and ensure accurate, complete documentation is retrieved from brokers and carriers and stored centrally on our platform

- Apply the HTS classifications and country-of-origin determinations that Legal & Compliance have approved, consistently across our shipment processes and systems in partnership with product

- Manage day-to-day customs broker relationships, coordinating clearance, reviewing broker performance, and ensuring broker practices stay aligned with our classification framework

- Monitor duties as part of landed shipping costs, catch unexpected duty outcomes, and file claims with customs brokers when errors are found

- Resolve routine customs queries during clearance, and ensure declarations for import and export are applied accurately

- Own the duty drawback program day to day, acting as the internal point of contact with Livingstone, and preparing and validating claims before submission

- Monitor the US import bond and keep it compliant, since this underpins business continuity for our largest lane

- Partnering with our manufacturers (starting with India) to ensure their export documentation and processes support compliant, duty-efficient shipping

- Identifying and acting on duty-saving opportunities through relevant free trade agreements (e.g. India-UK, EU-UK, EU-India, UAE-India)

- Building out trade compliance processes as our jewellery business scales into new duty-liable markets, and escalating complex classification or legal interpretation questions to Legal & Compliance

What do we need from you? 💪 

- Proven experience in global trade compliance or customs operations, with a track record on US, UK, EU import/export specifically

- Extensive US import-export experience is required.

- Direct experience managing customs broker relationships and shipment documentation at volume

- Experience filing duty drawback or tariff reclaim claims

- Comfortable working as an individual contributor with real autonomy

- Detail-oriented and process-minded: you'll be establishing how this works at Nivoda, not just following an existing playbook

- Based in the EU or UK, with the flexibility to work across time zones as we scale globally

- Strong stakeholder management skills, coordinating external brokers/carriers/manufacturers and internal Legal, Fulfilment, and Ops teams

- A commercial mindset, you connect compliance work back to cost savings and business impact

Nice to have ✨ 

- Experience with free trade agreements and preferential duty schemes (e.g. India–UK, EU–UK, EU–India, UAE–India)

- Experience in jewellery, diamonds, gemstones, or other high-value/luxury goods logistics

- Experience with Indian export processes

- Background in a fast-scaling, international e-commerce or marketplace business

Our culture and what we offer 😉 

At Nivoda, we believe that employees today want to evolve in a collaborative, high-growth environment where they can demonstrate their abilities and thrive both professionally and personally. We work to create a culture of empowerment, continuous learning, and growth where everyone can bring their expertise, own projects, and easily measure their impact. Dynamic working environment in a rapidly growing company. Enjoy a pleasant, low-hierarchy work environment. Engage in intellectually challenging work that contributes significantly to Nivoda's success and scalability.

Our current benefits 

🕰️ Flexible working and a vibrant company culture

💻 Remote work

🧠 Plenty of opportunities for growth and learning

🏖️ Unlimited holiday allowance

🚀 Chance to join and contribute to a company during its exponential expansion phase

Equal Opportunity 

Nivoda is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to promoting diversity. We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. title: Chief Financial Officer - Satispay Bank (Relocation to Luxembourg)
description:
Please note that this opportunity requires relocation to our Luxembourg office. 

About us 

Traditional banking has never really given people control over their financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance .

That means making financial services easy and accessible for millions of users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. Same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. Getting there takes leaders who own outcomes across teams, not just tasks, and set the tone for refusing the “someone else will fix this” culture. If that's how you lead, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be doing 

As CFO for our Luxembourg-regulated entity, you will be primarily responsible for maintaining the financial integrity, regulatory compliance, and fiscal oversight of Satispay's European hub. Acting as a regulator-approved key executive, your role involves aligning ambitious group-wide corporate goals with the demands of banking compliance, managing the local balance sheet, and safeguarding the entity's capital adequacy.
You will lead the entity's scalable Finance function, including statutory reporting, financial control, audit coordination, finance operations, and integration with the Group Finance organisation to support Satispay's growth and regulatory evolution.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

- Reporting & Compliance: Take full accountability for the preparation and delivery of local statutory accounts, regulatory filings, and financial information required for Group consolidation, ensuring the highest standards of accuracy, compliance, and timeliness. Ensure adherence to Lux GAAP/IFRS, applicable regulatory requirements, and Group reporting policies.

- Financial Strategy & Liquidity: Oversee the management of liquidity risks and the protection of client funds as per e-money statutes, while implementing effective yield-enhancement tactics for surplus liquidity. Lead treasury activities across the Luxembourg entity, including cash management, cash forecasting, and coordination with the Treasury team.

- Risk Management: Track and uphold institutional capital benchmarks, establishing proactive detection mechanisms for market and liquidity exposures. Partner closely with the Chief Risk Officer and other control functions to ensure effective oversight of financial risks, including liquidity, capital, and balance sheet-related risks.

- Stakeholder Representation: Act as Satispay's primary financial representative to regulatory bodies, tax offices, and external auditors, ensuring the successful execution of annual audits.

- Financial Control & Performance Reporting: Oversee the Financial Control and Controlling functions, ensuring accurate month-end reporting, balance sheet integrity, and timely management information for local and Group stakeholders. Provide financial analysis and insights to support strategic decision-making and business performance monitoring.

- Finance Operations: Ensure efficient and scalable Finance Operations processes, including reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and month-end close activities. Establish and maintain a strong financial control environment across all operational finance processes.

- Intercompany Integration: Work closely with the Group CFO and Finance teams to ensure seamless integration of local financial activities, reporting, treasury, and planning processes within the Group Finance framework.

You will lead and mentor high-performing teams, collaborate closely with peers with structured communication and transparency, demonstrating a commitment to integrity and ownership.

What we're looking for 

We are seeking a proven leader with a distinguished track record of success in driving strategic initiatives and achieving significant business growth within relevant sectors.
You will lead by example, combining ambition with purpose, drive impactful results and cultivate ownership and continuous improvement in our dynamic environment.

- Executive Experience: At least 8 years of leadership in financial roles at a primary EU financial hub or within Luxembourg-regulated payment institutions, EMIs, or banks.

- Compliance & Regulatory Mastery : Deep knowledge of CRR/CRD directives, CSSF requirements, Luxembourgish accounting (Lux GAAP/IFRS), and safeguarding standards.

- Regulatory Eligibility: Candidates must be qualified to meet the CSSF's "fit-and-proper" criteria necessary for official designation as an authorized director or manager

- Technical Core Competencies: Proven track record across treasury management, financial control, statutory and regulatory reporting, audit management, capital and liquidity management, and finance operations within regulated financial services environments. Strong understanding of Group consolidation processes, financial governance frameworks, and interaction with auditors, regulators, and supervisory authorities

- Language capabilities: Complete fluency in English

We recognise that exceptional leadership comes in many forms. If you believe you have the vision, experience, and drive to help us shape the future of money, we encourage you to apply. We value the unique perspectives and strengths that exceptional leaders bring, even if their experience doesn't align with every listed requirement.

Why this is your place 

This is a unique opportunity to leverage your experience and leadership to make a profound impact on a company poised for significant future growth. We operate on a principle of reciprocity: significant strategic impact is met with meaningful rewards and opportunities.

- Drive transformative impact. Lead critical functions and initiatives that directly contribute to our mission and impact millions of users and businesses.

- Operate in high-growth. Thrive in a dynamic, fast-moving environment that demands bravery, resilience, and rapid, decisive action at scale. Experience the excitement of navigating growth where change is constant, and the customer base/services are rapidly expanding.

- Significant equity participation. Directly share in Satispay's success through a competitive Stock Option Plan designed to reward leadership and contribution to company growth and raise the bar for collective success.

- Lead exceptional teams. Build, mentor, and collaborate with high-performing teams in a culture of ownership, collective success, and continuous improvement fueled by feedback. You will learn from the best and lead alongside founders who are hands-on.

CareAbout: how we support your impact 

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:

- ❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.

- 💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.

- ⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.

- 🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.

- 👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.

* We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time. 

Equal Opportunity Employer 

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin. 

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!
